# 1.38.0-beta.3

Third beta of 1.38.0: the session panel and conversation fixes.

## Session panel

- The right-hand panel now shows the current chat's context usage, agents and files created or changed by successful tools. It appears when there is enough free space beside the conversation.
- Context categories show approximate token counts. Attachments whose token usage cannot be measured are marked separately.
- Computer control and the agent browser can be disabled for an individual chat. These choices are saved with the conversation and respect the profile's settings and organization policies.
- Context compression and undo are connected to the chat's existing compression controls.

## Chat and agents

- Messages queued while tools are running are answered after the current reply finishes. They are also preserved if that work fails or is cancelled.
- Saved agent conversations are no longer limited to the latest 20.
- The chat's built-in instructions clarify how to report progress while a tool is running, without making a separate model request just to announce a wait. Unchanged saved copies of the previous default are updated automatically.

## Context compression

- Repeated compression preserves the previous summary when the new transcript exceeds the size limit.
- A summary is applied only if the part of the conversation sent for compression has not changed while the model was working.

## Microphone

- Recorded audio buffers keep their capture order when the recording queue wraps around.
- Microphone polling takes priority over rendering so the volume animation cannot delay capture.
